facts.statement: The saved settings caller imports initializer n as mt and component t as ht. Editor n resolves to Nt; t resolves to wt. wt chooses Tt for nullish environment and Et otherwise.
Creation selects the initial repository connector first, otherwise the cloud preference connector, otherwise null. Editing supplies preferredConnectorId null.
facts.qualification: Cloud preference provider values and repository picker behavior remain external.

facts.statement: Et initializes form values through Oe(environment, preferredConnectorId, initialRepository, default visibility). The default visibility is workspace when imported plan predicates pass, private otherwise.
facts.qualification: Oe, pe and ne are imported algorithms; their implementations were not replayed.

facts.statement: Local submission requires imported validation _e plus names ready or an unchanged trimmed label. Names ready means data is non-null or an imported API error has status 404.
facts.qualification: This proves the local gate and arguments, not validation rules or server error identity.

facts.statement: Creation calls P.mutate with requestBody be(value) and requestContext. Update calls me.mutate with environmentId, requestBody ye(value, environment) and requestContext.
facts.qualification: be and ye serialize externally; no wire-field equivalence or endpoint behavior is asserted.

facts.statement: Successful non-aborted settlement notifies, resets the form to submitted values, then calls onSaved with the new or original ID. Failed non-aborted settlement notifies without reset. Aborted context suppresses these callbacks.
facts.qualification: The local submit callback has no initial signal.aborted guard. Suppressing presentation does not prove transport cancellation.

facts.statement: requestClose returns while either mutation is pending. Otherwise a dirty form opens the unsaved dialog and a clean form calls onCancel. The exposed imperative ref uses that same handler.
facts.qualification: Closing is not an abort operation. Form library and dialog implementation remain separate boundaries.

facts.statement: The DOM form prevents the default event and calls form.handleSubmit. Name and description controls have maxLength 64 and 512; container-image membership is passed to the validator.
facts.qualification: HTML input limits do not establish server validation; form-hook duplicate-submit behavior was not tested.

facts.statement: Selecting a repository forwards its connector ID, repository ID and full name to form fields; label selection uses imported B. Only the first picker selection is forwarded.
facts.qualification: Repository query, ranking, authentication and label-generation algorithms remain external.

facts.statement: The dotenv paste helper skips empty/comment lines, accepts optional export and quoted values, strips unquoted comments, preserves empty values and rejects the whole paste on malformed input.
The repository picker and preinstalled-packages dialog are lazy module delegates. Their import locations are recorded, without generating another feature denominator.
